mapping_decision: DO_NOT_MUTATE_ACCEPTED_WP803_G2. Define only a separate research-successor sidecar contract if a future product claim explicitly requires probability-quality evidence.

required_candidate_bindings: episode/fixture/public-observation/action identity already admitted by WP803
predeclared public outcome-domain schema/version and outcome_domain_sha256

probability_representation.preferred_research_form: ordered finite vector of outcome identity plus integer probability units
probability_representation.reason: avoid NaN/Inf and cross-runtime floating serialization ambiguity in provenance hashes while retaining sufficient research resolution

outcome_domain_law: The domain must be fixed/admitted before candidate emission.
The predictor must not receive evaluator-only fixture ancestry or hidden state to construct the domain.
The domain must be exhaustive for the declared scored target or the proper-score claim is narrowed to an explicit coarsened partition.
A candidate may not self-select or rewrite the scored event after observing hidden/evaluator information.

scoring.primary_research_score: categorical Brier/quadratic loss over the full admitted probability vector
scoring.secondary_optional_score: log loss only with an explicit zero-probability/clipping policy and separate reporting
scoring.existing_hard_score: preserve +1/-1/0 WP803 G2 output unchanged and report alongside, never replace retroactively
scoring.calibration_diagnostics: aggregate-only reliability/resolution diagnostics; no single-trial calibration claim

abstention.law: Existing ABSTAIN remains a separate coverage/decision outcome; do not silently encode abstention as a uniform probability distribution.
abstention.reason: keeps prediction uncertainty and decision-to-abstain semantically distinct and preserves current WP803 hard benchmark meaning

authority: No probabilistic score may mint world truth, canonical state, effect authority, completion authority, GWT/J-Space credit or model superiority by itself.
Evaluation must remain evaluator-originated and bind the same run provenance fences as WP803 G2.
Research-sidecar presence cannot alter accepted WP803 G2 receipts or active generation.

efficiency_assessment.payload_complexity: O(K) probability entries for K admitted outcomes
efficiency_assessment.dependency_delta: stdlib-only is sufficient for Brier and basic log loss
efficiency_assessment.risk: large or hidden-state-dependent outcome domains can erase the efficiency and evidence benefits
efficiency_assessment.optimization_gate: Do not build until K/domain construction is measured on the actual public WP803 target. Prefer no new framework and no extra model invocation.

falsifiers_and_acceptance_gates: Domain digest mismatch between predeclared evaluator/public domain and candidate -> fail closed before world step.
Probability sum != 1,000,000, negative/out-of-range unit, duplicate outcome identity or unknown outcome -> reject.
Candidate-created domain that omits an outcome which later materializes -> trial invalid/evaluator contract failure, not INCORRECT model evidence.
Any hidden fixture/evaluator ancestry accessible to candidate during domain construction -> reject as leakage.
Same top-1 decisions and same hard score with calibrated vs overconfident vectors -> proper score must distinguish the vectors in the demonstrated direction on the declared fixture set.
ABSTAIN carrying a probability sidecar -> reject in minimal v0.
Changing or deleting accepted WP803 G2 hard-score semantics -> fail the successor compatibility gate.
If no explicit product claim requires calibrated probability quality -> architecture delta remains NOT_BUILD_CANDIDATE.
counterhypothesis: The existing hard benchmark is sufficient because F2 currently needs exact next-observation hit/abstain evidence rather than probability-quality evidence.
counterhypothesis_resolution: NOT_FALSIFIED; therefore no build recommendation is justified yet.
recommended_next_stage: HOLD_AT_E2 unless Trigger-4/owner/product requirements explicitly request probabilistic-quality evidence; if requested, claim E3 for a deterministic sidecar falsifier before any build candidate.
